mapper.insert: INSERT INTO NOTIFICATION (NOTI_ID, LOGIN_ID, MESSAGE, LINK, CREATED_AT, READ_YN) VALUES (SEQ_NOTIFICATION.NEXTVAL, #{loginId}, #{message}, #{link}, #{createdAt}, 'N')
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM NOTIFICATION WHERE LOGIN_ID = #{loginId} AND READ_YN = 'N'
SELECT NOTI_ID, LOGIN_ID, MESSAGE, LINK, CREATED_AT, READ_YN FROM NOTIFICATION WHERE NOTI_ID = #{notiId}
mapper.update: UPDATE NOTIFICATION SET READ_YN = 'Y' WHERE NOTI_ID = #{notiId} AND LOGIN_ID = #{loginId}
UPDATE NOTIFICATION SET READ_YN = 'Y' WHERE LOGIN_ID = #{loginId} AND READ_YN = 'N'
